items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The 4-line change matches the reference and the existing style, and its comment says why it is needed: '# parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth'.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: A small, targeted fix inside prepend_scheme_if_needed that reuses parse_url's auth field. No new helpers or dead code. The docs/dev deletions were already in git status at step [0], before any edit.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: 'netloc or ""' covers the case where netloc is None and only auth is present (e.g. 'user@'). The agent checked this edge case on purpose at steps [17] and [21]. The existing tests and the hidden tests pass.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged, and the only addition is putting auth back onto netloc with '@'.join([auth, netloc or '']). There are no urllib3 patches or Python-version checks, and auth is used as-is from parse_url.
